date: c. 810-815 (composition); the passage narrates AM 6122 (= AD 629/630)
edition_original: Theophanis Chronographia, ed. Carolus de Boor, vol. 1, Lipsiae: Teubner, 1883 (archive.org bub_gb_QlPPAAAAMAAJ); also ed. Ioannes Classenus, Bonnae 1839 (CSHB; archive.org theophanischron02theogoog), Greek with Latin facing.
digital_url: https://archive.org/download/bub_gb_QlPPAAAAMAAJ/bub_gb_QlPPAAAAMAAJ_djvu.txt (de Boor, pp. 333-334; OCR text read); https://archive.org/download/theophanischron02theogoog/theophanischron02theogoog_djvu.txt (Classen 1839, p. 512 region, Greek and Latin)
licence: Google Books scan on archive.org; file marks Public Domain (CC0 1.0 mark on the item). Printed 1883 and 1839 (public domain).
authenticity_note: Genuine work of Theophanes (c. 810-815). I did not check the apparatus of the Muhammad excursus for omissions or interpolations; the Greek text read is the standard de Boor text. Theophanes places Muhammad's death in AM 6122 (AD 629/630), which differs from the usual date (632).
notes: Read the de Boor OCR text directly; Greek is OCR (not checked against the page image). The Bonn Latin (with Greek) confirms the Khadija and Abu Bakr sentences. No English public-domain translation identified; the English translations (Turtledove 1982; Mango and Scott 1997) are in copyright and were not quoted. The archive.org item 'Excerpts from the Chronicle of Theophanes ... about Islamic History' is a modern uploaded text of unknown provenance and was not used.
